about.subtitle: Welcome
about.title: An Oasis of Tranquility
about.description: Sweet Bonihu offers a unique combination of Flemish hospitality and contemporary comfort. Our wellness suite is carefully designed to provide you with an unforgettable experience.
about.descriptionSecond: Located within walking distance of the historic center of Bruges, our B&B is the perfect base for both romantic weekends and relaxation trips — and your four-legged friend is also welcome and will certainly be pampered.

loft.name: The Loft
loft.subtitle: Luxury Wellness Suite
loft.description: Our gem on the second floor with private jacuzzi, infrared sauna in country style. Perfect for a romantic escape.
loft.contentDescription: "The Loft" is our gem, located on the second floor in romantic Bruges. This exceptional suite is equipped with a private jacuzzi and infrared sauna that you can enjoy unlimited.
loft.contentDescriptionSecond: Perfect for a romantic weekend, a honeymoon or simply to escape the daily hustle. Immerse yourself in luxury and relax in an atmospheric environment.

midsomer.name: Midsomer
midsomer.subtitle: Cozy Room
midsomer.description: Comfortable, functional room with private terrace and picnic breakfast. Ideal as a base for exploring Bruges and its surroundings.
midsomer.contentDescription: "Midsomer" is our cozy room where authentic Bruges charm and modern comfort come together. The warm atmosphere and carefully chosen details make your stay extra special.
midsomer.contentDescriptionSecond: This room is perfect for guests looking for a peaceful, homely atmosphere combined with all modern conveniences. Pets are very welcome here.
midsomer.petsDescription: At Midsomer, your four-legged friends are very welcome. We ensure a comfortable stay for the whole family.

romantic.contentDescription: Surprise your partner with an unforgettable experience. Our romantic package combines luxury, wellness and the enchanting atmosphere of Bruges into one unforgettable experience.
includes: Overnight stay in The Loft suite
romantic.priceDescription: Prices vary depending on the chosen dates and availability. Contact us for a personalized quote.

breakfast.contentTitle: The most important meal of the day
breakfast.contentDescription: Because breakfast is the most important meal of the day, our hostess prepares a generous, healthy and energizing picnic breakfast for you. This way, our guests can head out refreshed to explore and discover the beautiful historic Bruges.
breakfast.contentDescriptionSecond: The picnic breakfast includes a variety of quality meats and cheeses, smoked salmon and a delicious omelette. It also features 3 pieces of fresh seasonal fruit, Activia yogurt, 2 types of Kellogg’s cornflakes, Nutella, speculoos spread and an assortment of jams. Everything is served with baguette, croissants and sandwiches, along with fresh apple juice from Sint-Kruis, milk and Dolce Gusto coffee or decaf.
includes: Fresh croissants and quality bread varieties
breakfast.dietaryDescription: We are always happy to accommodate guests who prefer vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free or lactose-free breakfast options. A small surcharge applies, as we always want to offer the very best to our guests.
breakfast.contactInfo: For allergies or questions about our products, please speak with our hostess during check-in, or call us at +32476596011.
